messages.subject: blavaan 0.3-4 is released
parts:
blavaan 0.3-4 has just been released to CRAN. There are minor updates, most notably standardizedPosterior() to obtain the posterior distribution of standardized estimates. Some additional detail here: http://faculty.missouri.edu/~merklee/blavaan/version.html

Ed
